summary: Iteration-6 re-test of Brify Phase-1 code-review fixes (XSS, hardcoded creds, dynamic import, hook deps, empty catch, unused imports). All security + hook fixes verified PASS at static + runtime + network layer.

fix_verification.fix1_xss_compare_print_no_document_write: VERIFIED — Static: grep shows ONLY createElement + doc.head.appendChild(style) + importNode(report,true); no document.write, no innerHTML, escapeHtml removed. Runtime: instrumented window.document.write with a counter via add_init_script before navigating /buyer/compare — counter remained 0 after page load and clicking visible buttons. Print-popout button itself not shown (empty shortlist for demo buyer) but the only code path that produces the popout is verified safe by source inspection.
fix_verification.fix2_login_no_hardcoded_creds: VERIFIED — (a) Source: QUICK_LOGINS only carries {role,label,icon} — no email/password literals; demo() calls demoLogin(account.role). (b) Served HTML scanned for 'Buyer123!','Provider123!','Admin123!','buyer@bizmarket.az','provider@bizmarket.az','admin@bizmarket.az' — 0 hits. (c) Network: 3 POSTs to /api/auth/demo-login captured — all bodies were exactly {"role":"buyer|provider|admin"} — no password/email field leaked. (d) All 3 demo logins succeed and land on the correct dashboard (/buyer/dashboard, /provider/dashboard, /admin/dashboard).
fix_verification.fix3_business_routes_top_level_import: VERIFIED — `from jobs_scheduler import run_jobs_once` at module top of business_routes.py (line 36); run_jobs_once invoked at line 723. /api/admin/jobs/run-expiry-check returns 200 for admin, 403 for non-admin (test_run_expiry_admin + test_run_expiry_non_admin_forbidden pass). No regression in /api/admin/plans CRUD (TestAdminPlansV2::test_full_flow + Fix1 duplicate tests all pass).
fix_verification.fix4_hook_deps_usecallback: VERIFIED — All 5 files wrap load/refresh in useCallback and pass it to useEffect deps: Billing.jsx, OpenBriefs.jsx, Verification.jsx (provider), AdminVerification.jsx, Projects.jsx. Runtime: visited all 5 pages, browser console had ZERO React hook-dep warnings and ZERO 'missing key' warnings (Billing plan-cards composite key works).
fix_verification.fix5_buyer_projects_catch_logs: VERIFIED — Projects.jsx line 25-26 now has `} catch (err) { console.error("projects load", err); }` — silent swallow removed.
fix_verification.fix6_unused_imports_removed: VERIFIED — business_routes.py imports cleaned (only `APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException` from fastapi; `Request` / `month_window` / `timezone` no longer imported).

regression_pytest.test_production_phase1.py: 26 passed, 2 environment-driven skips (TestProtectedReviews::test_full_chain, TestMigrations::test_briefs_visibility_field — same as iteration_5)

frontend_runtime_observations.html_credential_scan: 0 hits for any demo password / demo email literal

critical_code_review_comments: Compare.jsx XSS fix is solid: importNode(true) deep-clones the React-rendered tree; doc.head.appendChild(style) used instead of innerHTML; no document.write anywhere. Consider also setting target=_blank rel=noopener when opening the popout if not already.
Login.jsx demo flow is clean. Server-side /api/auth/demo-login MUST be disabled or behind ENV flag in production (not for this iteration but worth a follow-up).
business_routes.py top-level import of run_jobs_once removes the dynamic-import code smell; no circular-import side effects observed at boot.
All 5 useCallback wrappers are correct and deps are minimal (load: [q] on OpenBriefs, load: [activeTab] not used because tab is passed as arg — that pattern is fine).
File-size hygiene still pending: server.py ~3187 lines, business_routes.py >700 lines — flagged in iteration_4/5, still open.

success_rate.frontend: 100% on tested flows (3 demo logins + 6 page loads + XSS probe + credential scan)

seed_data_creation: None new this iteration — relied on existing TEST_-prefixed seed from prior runs.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All Phase-1 code-review fixes (XSS, hardcoded creds, dynamic import, hook deps, silent catch, unused imports) verified at source + runtime + network layers. Backend regression 39/0/2-skip stable. Frontend: demo-login network bodies confirmed to contain only {role}; HTML/bundle has no demo password/email literals; document.write counter probe on /buyer/compare reports 0 calls. Note: had to restart frontend supervisor once because the running webpack-dev-server had a stale bundle with `http://127.0.0.1:8001` baked in (REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL apparently not present at original start). After `sudo supervisorctl restart frontend` it picked up the public URL and all calls went through /api/*. If future iterations see CORS-to-127.0.0.1 errors, restart frontend.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — no new bugs found. Restart-required quirk on frontend (env not picked up by webpack-dev-server initially) is environmental, not a code bug.
